newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANDELSBANKEN SAYS MOVE WILL BOOST MARKETS.
newsitem.headline: HANDELSBANKEN SAYS MOVE WILL BOOST MARKETS.

text.p: Leading Swedish bank Handelsbanken on Monday said its move into the Estonian market would bring it into competition with local banks but would also give a boost to the market's development.

Handelsbanken, the biggest bank in Sweden after merging with Stadshypotek, earlier announced it has bought Estonian broker Aktoris. It is the first foreign bank to get involved in the Baltic brokerage markets.

"Although it is quite true that we will be competing with the local banks as regards to corporate finance and the stock and sales on the stock exchange, we also believe in a way we will be assisting the growth of the total market," Handelsbanken Tallinn representative office head Bo Kragh said.
Estonia's stock exchange has grown quickly since it opened in 1996 and foreign and domestic interest has been growing.

"We hope that we can encourage foreign investors to this market and as a consequence the market should grow for everybody and should attract additional interest to the market and therefore be a boost to the stock market here," Kragh added.
